title: [finding] The permission-set projection drops _packageId, so an isDefault set in a runtime package records no everyone suggestion — and two framework reads disagree on its owner
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`) from the cloud dev report objectstack-ai/cloud#2847 `6143358759` (out-of-scope finding 1). It was measured on a real tenant kernel at framework `02bec6ca86`, and the code path is unchanged on `main` `150da61aa5`. ⛔ The seat files this; it does not fix the framework. Cloud is not blocked: its AI build now declares the spec's `packageId` on the set (objectstack-ai/cloud#2847, under ruling objectstack-ai/cloud#2858 A), so this is filed for every other author of such a set.

## What happens

- **The input:** a runtime package publishes a permission set marked `isDefault: true` through the package door (`publishPackageDrafts`), without a body `packageId`.
- **No suggestion is recorded:**
  - no `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` row is written;
  - `listAudienceBindingSuggestions` answers `synced.created: 0` and `suggestions: []`.

  ADR-0090 D5's "packages suggest, admins confirm" silently does not happen for that set.
- **The two framework reads disagree about who owns the set:**
  - read through `protocol.getMetaItem`, it carries `_packageId` and `packageId` (the package);
  - read through the security catalog, it has no owner.

  The projected `sys_permission_set` row is also `managed_by: 'admin'` with `package_id: null`.

## Where

1. **The strip:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts` `syncEvaluatorRegistry` registers `stripDecorations(body)`. That function removes `_packageId` together with the layered-read decorations, and it stamps `_provenance: 'org'` and the env-projection marker on the echo.
2. **The owner read:** `packages/core/src/security/security-catalog.ts` `ownerOf` reads only `_packageId`, so the catalog serves the echoed set as unowned.
3. **The skip:** `suggested-audience-bindings.ts` `collectDeclaredSuggestions` skips an unowned set, so no suggestion is collected.

The seam runs from spec `PermissionSetSchema.packageId` / `isDefault`, through runtime `syncEvaluatorRegistry`, to `collectDeclaredSuggestions`.

## Why it matters

- **A silent drop:** a package author who declares `isDefault: true` gets no error and no suggestion.
- **Inconsistent ownership:** the metadata read and the catalog read give different owners for one item, so any check that asks one of them can disagree with a check that asks the other.

## Priority

`priority:p2`: it does not block cloud's v18 upgrade (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709). Triage may re-rank.
